niche: an integrated care board's hypnotic deprescribing team placed in one primary care network, sized by the emergency fall admissions it avoids among older patients on Z-drugs and benzodiazepines
analyst_test: A strong analyst who reads every file correctly takes each network's fall-admission rate among its current hypnotic users, applies it to the users the team would take off the drug, and names the network with the most users and admissions, when a hypnotic's fall hazard is highest in the first months of use and that network's users are mostly years into theirs.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is the excess fall risk a deprescribing review removes, which pharmacoepidemiology reads by time since starting the drug (the early hazard and the depletion of susceptibles among long-term users), each patient's start taken from the repeat-template record rather than the first dispensing a truncated extract shows; swapped into a school's pupils or a feeder's megawatt-hours there is no exposure clock whose early months carry the harm.
layer1: practice codes merged and renamed within a network
a dispensing extract whose first month is April 2023
dm+d product codes against BNF chapter codes
admissions in an SUS-style extract with episodes and spells
dates of birth to age bands
the financial year against calendar months
stakeholder_role: the ICB's chief pharmacist, who chairs the medicines optimisation committee

spine.grain: patient x dispensing date x product

world.geography: England, an integrated care board area

driver: A harm concentrated in a unit's first months of exposure is priced at the cohort's average rate, when the candidate whose units are mostly long exposed has outlived the early hazard; each unit's exposure start lives in another record than the activity log, whose own start truncates the longest histories.
driver_concrete: The board prices the fall admissions a deprescribing team avoids at each network's crude admission rate among current hypnotic users, when the fall hazard is highest in the first months on the drug; each patient's start comes from the GP repeat-template start date, not the first dispensing in an extract that begins in April 2023 and makes long-term users look new, so the network whose users are mostly long-term avoids far fewer admissions than its crude rate implies.
stump: A competent analyst applies each network's crude fall-admission rate among current hypnotic users to the users the team would take off the drug and names the network with the most users; the step that lands them there is pricing every user at the cohort's average risk, when the risk falls after the first months on the drug and that network's users started years ago.

differentiation.task131: task131 moves load out of a window and prices the synchronised surge when it returns; this build prices an exposure's excess harm by time since the exposure began, nothing moved or returned
differentiation.task169: task169 corrects a forward rate for one of two processing routes a filed change closes; here no route or filed change: the harm falls with time on the drug and the start date sits in another record
differentiation.task183: task183 conditions a part's rate on its own count of past failures; this build conditions the excess risk on time since the exposure started, recovered from a start record the truncated activity log cannot show
differentiation.task230: task230 corrects a category count for a late processing channel's classification bias; nothing here is classified or processed late
differentiation.task446: task446 weights a signal by the component that raised it; here no signal or component: each unit's excess risk follows its own exposure clock

lineage.driver: The gain a specialist team adds to a unit is its effect on the reachable volume the unit does not already treat itself, because the unit's own past trials, which supply the measured effect, have already banked their gains in the volume carried forward; every closed deployment went to units that had never run a trial of their own, so the shrunk effect times reachable volume reproduces all of them, while the unit leading on that basis already treats the items that carry most of its reachable volume and a unit that has treated little of its own overtakes it.
lineage.stump: A competent solver rebuilds each desk's winning lift from the test archive, shrinks it as the seven closed embeddings' realised holdback lifts require, counts only the clicks that start on surfaces that show the tested headline, and names Local·metro at 2,800,000; the step that lands them there is never asking who ran the tests behind each desk's lift, which the archive's test owners joined to the newsroom staff list answer: Local·metro's own editors already test the headlines behind 71.1% of its platform clicks, so most of the gain the squad was sized on is already in the plan.

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is the share of an item's measured gain that is new to the whole system rather than taken from the items shown beside it, which is one minus the rate at which a view of the shared display already ends in a choice; a unit whose volume arrives through displays that nearly always convert keeps little of its measured gain, so the unit leading on the measured gain falls behind one whose volume arrives through displays that rarely convert.
